string.text: Stalkers stay on their feet at low health instead of lying wounded.

Unchecking story exclusion may conflict with quest scripts that rely on wounded state. Monolith exclusion preserves their wounded suicide grenade behavior. Companion exclusion keeps squad revival and wounded companion mechanics intact. Excluded story NPCs and companions are ignored as enemies while wounded.
Stalkers treat you as unarmed for meet/warning checks while your weapon is out. Toggles off instantly via MCM.
